en: The image is a historical black-and-white photograph showing a large group of clergy in elaborate religious vestments performing a ceremonial ritual around a cornerstone or commemorative stone. A wooden crate, possibly containing relics, is being opened or blessed by the clergy. There are many other people present witnessing the event, including some in formal attire. In the foreground, the photo is stamped with the name 'A. Bandella TRENTO.'
